question: According to the passage, non-verbal communication mainly helps to:
solution: The correct answer is: **Option (3) i.e. Express subtle, implied meanings**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Non-verbal communication** includes body language, facial expressions, gestures, and tone, which help to convey meanings that are not always directly stated. (गैर-मौखिक संचार सूक्ष्म, संकेतित अर्थ व्यक्त करने में मदद करता है।) • It goes beyond words to express attitudes, emotions, and nuances, enriching overall communication and helping others understand unspoken intentions. • The passage emphasizes that communication is more than just words, highlighting the importance of non-verbal cues in achieving shared understanding. Therefore, the correct answer is- Express subtle, implied meanings [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Replace spoken language** (मौखिक भाषा को प्रतिस्थापित करना): Non-verbal communication usually supplements, not replaces, spoken language. • **Add decorative elements** (सजावटी तत्व जोड़ना): Its primary purpose is not decoration, but conveying meaning. • **Avoid interaction** (संपर्क से बचना): It facilitates and enhances interaction instead of avoiding it. 40:T92e, The correct answer is: **Option (3) i.e. Loss of trust and clarity**.
